title: AI Graffiti Generator
summary: Make graffiti with AI: wildstyle letters of your own word, bubble throw-ups, stencils, character murals and blackbook sketches. Describe it and generate.
body_markdown:
### Can AI write my name in graffiti?


Yes. Put your name in quotes in the prompt, name a letter style such as wildstyle or bubble letters, and say the piece shows just that word, so the model spells your name without adding stray lettering.


### Is the AI graffiti generator free?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and both GPT Image 2.6 and the Auto video model run on it.


### What are the main graffiti styles?


The main graffiti styles are the tag, a quick signature; the throw-up, fast bubble letters in one or two colours; the piece, a larger multicolour work; wildstyle, interlocking letters with arrows; 3D block letters; and characters painted beside the letters.


### Can I use AI graffiti as a sketch for a real wall?


Yes. Ask for the design flat on a blackbook page or straight on against the wall, then use it as a reference for colours and layout; painting it on a wall still needs the owner's permission.


### Can I make graffiti animation with AI?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe motion around the piece, such as paint mist from the can or a train passing, and ask it to keep the letters as they are.


### How do I make graffiti letters without readable words?


Ask for abstract interlocking letter shapes with no readable words, as in the throw-up and chrome piece on this page, which keeps the energy of graffiti lettering without spelling anything.
